content: Metabolic surgery, specifically Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) and vertical sleeve gastrectomy (VSG), has been shown to be highly effective in alleviating symptoms of type 2 diabetes and sustaining glycemic control for up to five years after the procedure. Clinical evidence suggests that approximately 30% to 63% of individuals with type 2 diabetes experience remission of the disease within one to five years following metabolic surgery. The STAMPEDE trial, which studied patients with advanced type 2 diabetes, reported that 29% of participants who underwent RYGB achieved an A1C level of less than 6.0% over a five-year period.
